mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_step (document_id, step_order, approver_level, approver_employee_id) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{stepOrder}, #{approverLevel}, #{approverEmployeeId})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.document_id, s.step_order, s.approver_level, s.approver_employee_id, e.name AS approver_name, a.action AS action_result, a.comment AS action_comment FROM approval_step s JOIN employee e ON e.id = s.approver_employee_id LEFT JOIN approval_action a ON a.step_id = s.id WHERE s.document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY s.step_order
